query: Best possible methods for automating the creation of full, comprehensive E2E test suites for mobile apps backed by Firebase Functions (possibly integrating with web apps), with the end goal of a one-command LLM-driven tool (e.g. /generate-e2e) that studies the codebase feature by feature, produces a behavioral specification, and from it generates a working comprehensive E2E suite. Reference target: ~/dev/recovery-platform/regroup.
audience: Solo developer / small team building Claude Code tooling (skills, scripts, plugins) for their own React Native + Firebase + Angular projects.
decision_informed: What architecture to build for /generate-e2e (and what not to build), which frameworks/runtimes to target, what is realistically automatable, and how to prove generated suites are correct and non-flaky.

in_scope: React Native mobile apps (regroup is RN 0.72) with Firebase Auth/Firestore/Storage/Functions backends; Angular/other web companions
LLM-driven code comprehension, spec extraction, test generation, run-and-repair loops
Mobile E2E frameworks (Maestro, Detox, Appium, Patrol, native XCUITest/Espresso) and their agent/MCP integrations
Firebase Emulator Suite, data seeding, functions/triggers testing, third-party service stubbing (Stripe, SendGrid)
Commercial AI testing tools as comparison points and possible components
Academic research on LLM GUI/mobile testing and LLM test generation, including failure evidence
Methods for evaluating generated suite quality (mutation testing, coverage, flake rate, oracle strength)
excluded: Unit-test generation except where it informs E2E methods
Vendor pricing negotiation; detailed cost modeling beyond order-of-magnitude

angles.A1: Mobile E2E frameworks and runtime layer: Maestro vs Detox vs Appium vs Patrol etc. for RN; reliability/flakiness; LLM/MCP operability (Maestro MCP, mobile-mcp, Appium MCP); CI/device clouds
angles.A2: Research evidence on LLM-driven test generation and LLM GUI/mobile testing agents (academic + industrial: e.g. Meta TestGen-LLM, GPTDroid, DroidAgent, AutoDroid, LLM-for-testing surveys); success rates, failure modes, oracle problem
angles.A3: Code-to-specification: static analysis + LLM app comprehension; extracting navigation graphs, features, roles, user flows, business rules from code; spec formats (Gherkin/BDD, flow docs, state machines); spec-driven development tooling (spec-kit, Kiro etc.); long-context vs chunked repo understanding
angles.A4: Firebase backend in E2E: Emulator Suite, functions/triggers in emulators, seeding/reset, auth fixtures, rules testing, backend assertions, stubbing Stripe/SendGrid, connecting RN apps and web apps to emulators, cross-platform (mobile+web) flows
angles.A5: Commercial / novel AI testing products and autonomous exploration: Firebase App Testing Agent, Maestro AI features, QA Wolf, Momentic, Octomind, testRigor, Mabl, Autify, Revyl, Applitools, Google Robo; self-healing; vision-based agents; independent evaluations and criticisms
angles.A6: Orchestration and quality assurance of generated suites: multi-agent pipelines in Claude Code (skills/subagents/hooks/plugins), generate-run-repair loops, mutation testing for E2E/test adequacy, flakiness detection, avoiding tests that encode bugs, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, cost/token budgets

local_case_study: regroup-case.md (firsthand evidence from regroup's prior Maestro/Detox E2E attempts, cited as L-series)
tooling: Built-in WebSearch + WebFetch only (per skill contract); local file reads for the case study
workspace_note: Run directory placed in research repo subject dir ai-dev/ per repo CLAUDE.md, overriding the skill's ~/Documents default.
